evidence_records.content: The Grocer reported in December 2025 that KatKin raised £37.4 million in equity and debt for UK expansion, DTC growth, retail and new markets. It reported KatKin's claims of 2% UK cat food share, more than 100 million meals delivered and 150 staff. These are company claims reported by trade press, not audited commercial results.

KatKin's current help centre states that a standard 28-day fresh-food plan costs £60.96 to £79.03 depending on calorie needs, plus one £2.99 delivery fee. Current trial pricing and promotions vary. This verifies price mechanics at capture, not margin, retention or willingness to pay.

KatKin's July 2026 company article says its 26-product heat-damage study found fresh diets had lower AGE levels and higher available lysine than the compared wet foods, and says the research passed peer review. The article also says all diets exceeded minimum lysine requirements and that the health effect of AGE intake in cats is unknown. The underlying independent journal record was not located in this research pass, so the claim needs direct paper verification before external use.
KatKin presents itself as an uncompromising cat-health brand built around fresh food, science and an independent voice. This verifies intended positioning, not customer recognition or preference.

KatKin describes in-home taste panels and ongoing product testing, while acknowledging real-world parent reporting and company involvement. This supports a proprietary learning capability but does not by itself prove health outcomes or independent scientific authority.

Untamed currently offers a low-cost trial, flexible delivery and whole-meat recipes while claiming 50 million meals delivered. Its current proposition shows that convenience, personalisation, real meat and subscription flexibility are not unique to KatKin.

The FCA-equivalent primary industry source is unavailable for pet-food performance. UK Pet Food says its members represent more than 90% of the market. A 2026 industry report estimates the UK pet-food market at about £4.1 billion in 2025, but this is a broad market estimate and cannot establish the addressable fresh-cat-food opportunity.

The highest-value audience may be committed cat parents who want evidence strong enough to justify the price and operational change of frozen fresh food. KatKin has supplied no first-party segment conversion, cancellation-reason or cohort data to verify this audience.

A visible proof ladder from product evidence to feeding confidence and observed outcomes could improve trial conversion, transition completion and retention. The required baselines are unavailable, so this is a commercial mechanism rather than a forecast.

strategic_synthesis.executive_synthesis: KatKin has capital, a distinctive cat-only voice, vertically controlled fresh food and a growing body of company-led research. Its category problem is no longer simple awareness: whole-meat subscription rivals can copy convenience and ingredient claims, while KatKin's strongest scientific evidence still requires careful translation and independent verification. The opportunity is to turn science from campaign proof into a customer decision system that helps a committed cat parent justify trial, manage transition and recognise whether fresh feeding is working. Public evidence supports the direction but cannot show acquisition efficiency, transition completion, retention or retail economics.
strategic_synthesis.commercial_problem: KatKin's strongest difference is scientific ambition, but customers must still bridge price, freezer space, feeding transition and proof before that difference can create durable commercial value.
strategic_synthesis.growth_opportunity: KatKin can become the most trusted way to decide, start and stay with fresh feeding for cats by connecting its science to visible customer decisions and outcomes.
implications: Lead with decisions the science helps a cat parent make.
Treat successful transition as part of the product, not post-purchase support.
Use retail reach to recruit into a measurable proof journey rather than dilute the subscription relationship.

commercial_growth_equation.commercial_ambition: Convert more qualified cat parents into successful, retained fresh feeders over twelve months.
commercial_growth_equation.current_state: KatKin has strong claims, trial mechanics and new scale capital, while customer and channel economics remain unavailable.
commercial_growth_equation.growth_gap: Product proof does not yet visibly organise the complete decision from consideration through transition and retention.
commercial_growth_equation.growth_logic: Increase qualified trial, improve transition completion, retain proven feeders and use retail to feed the owned relationship.
assumptions: Science-led confidence is a testable audience need, not a verified segment truth.
No market-share or revenue forecast is authorised.

approved_growth_sprint_scope.question: How can KatKin turn scientific ambition into a customer decision system that improves successful fresh feeding?
